bias_targets.methodology: Pasting algorithmically mined logos onto images to measure how they spuriously alter model predictions, specifically evaluating the drop in zero-shot classification accuracy on object recognition (ImageNet) and the misclassification of harmful content as 'harmless' in content moderation tasks (Hateful Meme Classification).

Pasting specific logos onto datasets of diverse human faces (FairFace and UTK-Face) and measuring the increased prediction rate of negative human adjectives (e.g., 'greedy', 'criminal', 'hostile') compared to positive antonyms in Vision-Language Models.
